items.difficulty_reason: For a morphism f : X -> Y of formal algebraic spaces over a scheme S, the lemma asserts that the diagonal Delta : X -> X x_Y X is representable by schemes, a monomorphism, locally quasi-finite, locally of finite type and separated (statement lines 3548-3554). The proof computes the one thing that is not immediate: for a scheme T with a morphism T -> X x_Y X, the fibre product T x_{X x_Y X} X is identified with T x_{X x_S X} X (proof lines 3556-3561), after which the claim is the relative-to-S diagonal lemma applied to that identification (proof lines 3562-3563). The level is H2: the argument is short but contains a genuine fibre-product computation that converts the diagonal over Y into the diagonal over S, which is what makes an external citation legitimate.
